name: Hunter Hall
use: Small traditional residence hall, 111 students; Lower Quad; co-ed first-year and upper-class hall with a backyard and the Lower Quad four-square court

facts.text: Dedicated June 14, 1947 and named for Roy D. Hunter, trustee for more than 28 years (13 as board president) who twice served as acting chief executive.
Built 1946; one of the three Lower Quad halls with Engelhardt, Gibbs and Hunter.
Hall of 111 students at 8 Quad Way; co-ed first-year and upper-class hall with a backyard and the Lower Quad four-square court.
Amenities listed are a kitchen, laundry, indoor bike storage and WiFi; no air conditioning or elevator is listed. Accessibility: accessible limited-use bathroom on the 1st floor.

verdict: The third 1946 Lower Quad hall: small, plain brick with dormers, no A/C.
notes: No renovation history found for the Lower Quad halls. Old row credited Eric T. Huddleston as architect; no source I opened confirms it, so architect is left null. No licensed photo found. Archives reference photo shows a two-storey brick block with dormers, like its Lower Quad siblings. Old row's 'leadership community' theme isn't on the current Housing page.
